description:
Execute JavaScript against the CAD session — THE tool for any build involving computation, repetition, or more than a handful of operations. The script runs as an async function body with:
• api.v1.<domain>.<method>(params) — ClassCAD calls, await-able, → { result, maxLevel, messages }. Typos throw immediately with suggestions. Strict: a call that ends at maxLevel ≥ 51 THROWS (the message carries the engine error) — method docs describing "null/[] with maxLevel 51" are the non-script result; wrap intentional probes (e.g. getGeometryIds where a miss is expected) in try/catch.
• await api.tree({ refresh? }) — the structure tree (id → node): find parts, features, sketches by class/name. Returns a Promise: without await, Object.values(api.tree()) is silently [] (looks like an empty drawing).
• await api.graphic({ recalc? }) — the graphic payload (containers with face meshes, edges, vertices): find and FILTER GEOMETRY yourself — e.g. locate a bore wall by vertex radius, collect edge ids for a chamfer. Exact shapes + selection idioms: docs(["DATA"]).
• Math, full JS (variables, loops, functions); console.log/log(...) captured and returned.
• return <small summary> — results are size-capped; keep big data in the drawing, not the return value.
Compute coordinates IN the script (trigonometry, loops) instead of inlining hand-evaluated numbers. Pass recalc:false to api.graphic() in solid.*/entity-injection sessions (a recalc invalidates curve shape ids and can destroy injected bodies in complex cases). No DOM/network/filesystem access; awaited work times out (default 60s). Prefer several small verified scripts over one huge one — STATE PERSISTS in the drawing between scripts: a follow-up script ATTACHES to the existing model (re-discover via await api.tree(); tree ids are stable; NEVER part.create when a part already exists). Even a single operation is a run_script.

label.description: Short label describing what this script does.

script.description: JavaScript source. Executed as an async function body — use await directly, return a (small) summary value.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for awaited work in ms (default 60000).
